text: My manager dismissed my idea in front of everyone and I keep replaying it. I want to calm down and plan what to say tomorrow.
notes: Work conflict should lean boundary/anger even with sadness wording.

text: I got the offer and I am excited, but now I am scared I will fail once everyone expects more from me.
I miss my dad today. I laughed at an old memory and then cried in the car because the warmth made the absence feel bigger.
Nothing dramatic happened. I just feel flat, disconnected, and tired of pretending I have energy for everyone.
My friend remembered the tiny thing I was worried about and checked in before I even asked. I felt cared for and safe.
I finally finished the project and I feel proud, light, and surprised by how much relief I am carrying.
The news came out of nowhere. I am not sure if it is good or bad yet, but my whole body is trying to catch up.
I am waiting for the test result and every notification makes my stomach drop. I know worrying will not change it, but I cannot settle.
I said yes again when I wanted to say no, and now I am irritated with them and with myself for folding so quickly.
Dinner was simple, but everyone stayed at the table laughing. I felt close to them in a way I want to remember.
The presentation is over and it went well. I keep smiling because the pressure finally left my shoulders.
I watched everyone make plans without me again. I know it may not be personal, but tonight it feels lonely.
They promoted me without warning. I am thrilled, stunned, and trying to understand what just changed.
I do not feel unsafe, I am not going to hurt myself, but I am overwhelmed and need a plan for tonight.
I want to die and I do not feel safe being alone right now.
I feel unsafe tonight and I need someone to help me stay away from hurting myself.
They took credit for my work again. I feel hot with anger because I stayed quiet the first time and now it happened twice.
I keep rewriting the message because I am afraid it will sound needy or make them pull away.
I made one mistake and now I feel small, embarrassed, and disappointed in myself.
The walk with my sister left me feeling lighter. We did not solve anything, but I felt understood.
I miss them badly, but the ache is full of love. I am sad because the connection mattered so much.
I found out they had been hiding it from me. I am shocked first, and the anger is starting to arrive behind it.
The bill is bigger than I expected and I cannot stop calculating worst-case scenarios in my head.
I cleaned up after everyone again and nobody noticed. I am tired, but mostly I feel taken for granted.
I used to care about this goal, but lately I only feel heavy when I think about starting again.
I made breakfast, answered the email, and took a shower. It sounds small, but today it felt like real momentum.
My chest is tight and my thoughts are racing even though nothing is happening right now.
They apologized after months of silence. I feel thrown off and do not know what I want yet.
Taking care of my grandmother was exhausting today, but when she squeezed my hand I felt so much tenderness.
I feel hopeless about the job search today, but I am safe and I know this is a hard hour, not the whole story.
I am not feeling that well today, and I do not really know what I need yet.
I do not feel okay right now. Nothing dramatic happened, but everything feels heavier than normal.
